Hero.headline: Frontend Developer · React & TypeScript
Hero.description: I build responsive web applications with React and TypeScript, drawing on commercial frontend experience. My personal projects also include backend development with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL.

About.description:
Hi, I'm Xiaonan. 👋

I’m a frontend developer working with React and TypeScript. I enjoy turning UI designs into responsive applications with clear state and polished interactions.

In my previous frontend role, I collaborated with designers, backend engineers and a mobile team to build web interfaces and integrate APIs. I’m looking for frontend opportunities where I can contribute to thoughtful, reliable user experiences.

My personal projects also include Next.js route handlers, runtime validation, authentication and relational data using Prisma and PostgreSQL. This experience helps me understand how the interface connects to the API and database.
